Definition: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
BiblicalUsage: 1) to fear, revere, be afraid; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to fear, be afraid; 1a2) to stand in awe of, be awed; 1a3) to fear, reverence, honour, respect; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be fearful, be dreadful, be feared; 1b2) to cause astonishment and awe, be held in awe; 1b3) to inspire reverence or godly fear or awe; 1c) (Piel) to make afraid, terrify; 2) (TWOT) to shoot, pour
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
